correctness.rationale: The entire domain consists of (3^15−1)/2=7,174,453 normalized nonzero ternary quartic forms. Exact smoothness follows from the rank-36 degree-seven multiplication map S4^3→S7 on three cubic partials: no projective common zero implies an Artinian degree-(3,3,3) complete intersection with socle degree six; rank36 converse via homogeneous ideal. Inspected exhaustive orbit C++ source using generators for PGL3(F3), yielding 1557 orbits; all smooth classes identified at rank36 (805 orbits, 4,099,680 weighted forms), and 17-row (r,h) counts. Inspected independent full-form high-flex scan and representative cross-check, plus stored exact tables; direct scan examines 7,174,453 forms and smoothness of 6097 high-contact candidates, with 936 smooth maxima and none with ≥8. Independently re-evaluated exemplar F=X³Y+2X³Z+XZ³+Y⁴ over all 13 F3 projective points and all 7 curve rational points: precise six order-three contacts and one order-four at [0:0:1], no others. This independent exemplar check does not replace complete C++ enumeration, whose source and finite exhaustive iteration were inspected.
